test_title: PYST 63: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the grammatically correct sentence.

options.text: The carpenter kept furniture in the backyard of his house.
The carpenter kept the furniture in a backyard of his house.
The carpenter kept a furniture in the backyard of his house.
The carpenter kept the furniture in backyard of his house.

solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**the furniture**" is grammatically correct because the definite article "**the**" is used to refer to specific furniture.
 
• The term "**backyard of his house**" is appropriate because it specifies the location clearly.
 
• Options 2, 3, and 4 contain errors:
 
 
• Option 2: "a backyard" is incorrect because it implies there are multiple backyards, which is unlikely for a single house.
 
• Option 3: "a furniture" is incorrect because "furniture" is an uncountable noun and does not use the article "a."
 
• Option 4: "in backyard" is incorrect because it omits the article "the" before "backyard."
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The carpenter kept furniture in the backyard of his house."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** The use of "a backyard" is incorrect because it implies the house might have more than one backyard, which is uncommon.
 
• **Option 3:** The use of "a furniture" is incorrect because "furniture" is uncountable and does not take the article "a."
 
• **Option 4:** The omission of the article "the" in "in backyard" makes the sentence grammatically incorrect.

``
